arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'pending_booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'customer_events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('kind',e.kind,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT 'fare_hold' AS kind,json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) AS data FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT b.*, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS charges, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'kind',e.kind,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) AS customer_events, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b2.booking_id,'status',b2.status,'request_id',b2.request_id)) FROM bookings b2 WHERE b2.client_reference=b.client_reference) AS matching_reference FROM bookings b WHERE status='pending'
